eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Minimum age is 21 years for male and 18 years for female.
आवेदक उत्तर प्रदेश का निवासी होना चाहिए।
पुरुष की न्यूनतम आयु 21 वर्ष और महिला की न्यूनतम आयु 18 वर्ष होनी चाहिए।

application_process_steps.title_en: Open and register on the eDistrict Portal
application_process_steps.description_en: Open the eDistrict Uttar Pradesh portal at https://edistrict.up.gov.in/edistrictup/, click Citizen Login (e-Sathi), register using personal and contact details, receive the generated password through SMS or email, and log in using the User ID and Password.
After logging in, select the 'ESATHI INTEGRATED SERVICES' radio button.
Select the 'Marriage Certificate' service under the Stamp & Registration Department.
Create the profile by selecting the district and entering the date of birth and mobile number.
Pay the user charges of Rs. 15 through the online payment gateway.
Fill in the details in the Marriage Certificate application form and attach the required documents.

application_process_steps.title_en: Select appointment date and pay service fee
application_process_steps.description_en: Select the desired appointment date and pay the applicable Marriage Certificate fee through the online portal.
Preview the application and submit it online.
The applicant must appear physically with their spouse at the concerned Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) on the selected appointment date.
The final Marriage Certificate will be uploaded to the online portal by the Registrar officer.
The applicant can download the final certificate from the online portal or DigiLocker.

fees.calculation: Calculated from the date of marriage until the date of applying for the marriage certificate.

unknown_fields: processing time other than appointment date

vector_db_chunks.text: Service: Marriage Certificate (विवाह प्रमाण पत्र), Uttar Pradesh. Department: Stamp & Registration. Applicants must be residents of Uttar Pradesh. Minimum age is 21 years for male and 18 years for female. Marital status must be married. SLA is stated as on the appointment date.
Required Documents for Marriage Certificate (UP): Identity Proof (70 KB), Address Proof (70 KB), Age Proof (70 KB), Current Photo (40 KB), and Marriage Ceremony Proof.

Marriage Certificate application process in Uttar Pradesh: 1. Open the eDistrict portal, select Citizen Login (e-Sathi), register and log in. 2. Select ESATHI INTEGRATED SERVICES. 3. Select Marriage Certificate under Stamp & Registration Department. 4. Create profile using district, date of birth and mobile number. 5. Pay Rs. 15 user charges online. 6. Fill application details and attach documents. 7. Select appointment date and pay the Marriage Certificate fee. 8. Preview and submit the application. 9. Applicant and spouse must appear physically at the concerned SRO office on the appointment date. 10. Registrar officer uploads the final certificate. 11. Applicant downloads the certificate from the online portal or DigiLocker.

Marriage Certificate fees in Uttar Pradesh: User charges are Rs. 15 fixed. Service fee is Rs. 50 per year, with duration calculated from the date of marriage until the date of applying for the marriage certificate. Payment mode is online.
